name: Hagane Machinery
description: A calm, photograph-led theme for an industrial machinery maker: steel-white ground, light steel panels and graphite text with a single tetsu-onando iron blue-grey accent, IBM Plex Serif over IBM Plex Sans. The home page opens in two halves: a wide, low-key photograph of the machining hall at dawn over one plain sentence and three figures. Then the four product lines as a numbered index, one flagship machine explained with numbered notes and a short specification list, sixty-five years as a horizontal timeline, an interview with the chief engineer, delivered machines by industry, the service network, news and a request for a quotation. With Machines, How we build, Industries, Service, Engineers, About, Contact, Newsletter and News. The company details are one synced pattern, edited once. Sample content in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German.
